spreads.left_story_text: Nova beeped beside the blue rug river, beep-beep, small and slow. Maya tapped her pencil twice: I know a bridge can help you go.
spreads.right_story_text: Engineer Alex smiled and said, First measure, then we play. Maya marked the blueprint lines and planned the bridge the clever way.

spreads.left_story_text: Click went the blocks, then clack, then flop! The bridge leaned left and right. Maya grinned and tried again: Almost means I'm learning right.
spreads.right_story_text: Alex drew three sturdy sides and Maya's eyes grew wide. Triangles catch the wobbles fast and tuck the strength inside.
spreads.layout_note: Funny wobble test and triangle principle.

spreads.left_story_text: Nova marched across the bridge, beep-boop, bright and bold. Maya held her blueprint high: I built it from my plan!
spreads.layout_note: Final bridge success plus Canva review space.
